##2. relative balance
```{r}
library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
library(ggplot2)
setwd("D:/Other-project/N/New_1439/1.2 相对平衡/richness")
abundance<-read.csv("richness_scale_ph.csv",header=T,row.names=1)
env<-read.csv("env_china_update_1439.csv",header=T,row.names=1)
ab_env<-merge(abundance,env,by = "row.names")
df_2=ab_env[ab_env$depth=="20",]
df_5=ab_env[ab_env$depth=="50",]
df_10=ab_env[ab_env$depth=="100",]
df_env<-df_2
y<-cbind(df_env$Denitrification,df_env$Dissimilatory.nitrate.reduction,df_env$Nitrification,df_env$Assimilatory.nitrate.reduction,df_env$Organic.degradation.and.synthes,df_env$Nitrogen.fixation)
colnames(y)<-c("Denitrification","Dissimilatory.nitrate.reduction","Nitrification","Assimilatory.nitrate.reduction","Organic.degradation.and.synthesis","Nitrogen.fixation")
result <- aggregate(y ~ site, data = df_env, FUN = mean)

df_long <- result %>%
  pivot_longer(cols = -site, names_to = "Process", values_to = "Value")
df_proportions_2 <- df_long %>%
  group_by(site) %>%
  mutate(Proportion = Value / sum(Value)) %>%
  ungroup()

# 计算 'Organic.degradation.and.synthesis' 的总比例，用于排序
df_proportions_2$site <- factor(df_proportions_2$site,
                               levels = df_proportions_2%>%
                                 filter(Process == "Organic.degradation.and.synthesis") %>%
                                 arrange(desc(Proportion)) %>%
                                 pull(site))
# 绘图
p<-ggplot(df_proportions_2, aes(x = site, y = Proportion, fill = Process)) +
    geom_bar(stat = "identity") +  # 使用堆积柱状图
    labs(x = "site", y = "Proportion", title = "Proportions of Nitrogen Processes by site") +
    scale_fill_manual(values = c("Denitrification" = "#FDB462",
                                 "Dissimilatory.nitrate.reduction" = "#4DAF4A",
                                 "Nitrification" = "#66C2A5",
                                 "Assimilatory.nitrate.reduction" = "#FB8072",
                                 "Organic.degradation.and.synthesis" = "#9e9ac8",
                                 "Nitrogen.fixation" = "#377EB8")) +  # 固定颜色
    theme_bw() +
    theme(
        axis.text = element_text(colour = 'black', size = 9, angle = 90, hjust = 1),
        panel.grid.major = element_blank(),  # 移除主网格线
        panel.grid.minor = element_blank()   # 移除次网格线
    )
p


##按照0-20的进行排序
# 计算 Biome 的频数
scale_2 <- as.data.frame(table(df_proportions_2$Biome))
write.csv(scale_2,"scale_10.csv")
# scale_10<-read.csv("scale_10.csv")

# 将 Biome 列重新设置为因子，并按照 scale 中的顺序进行排序
df_env<-df_5
y<-cbind(df_env$Denitrification,df_env$Dissimilatory.nitrate.reduction,df_env$Nitrification,df_env$Assimilatory.nitrate.reduction,df_env$Organic.degradation.and.synthes,df_env$Nitrogen.fixation)
```

##3.SEM
```{r}
library(MASS) # install.packages("MASS") 
library(lavaan)
library(lavaan.survey) #
library(AICcmodavg) 
library(car)
library(piecewiseSEM) #
library(tidyverse)
library(nlme)
library(lme4)
library(brms)
library(ape)
library(caper) #
library(emmeans)
library(readxl)
library(tidytree) #
library(blavaan) #
library(rstan)
library(rstantools)
library(future) 
library(loo)
library(bayesplot)
library(dplyr) # Data manipulation
library(lubridate) # Data manipulation
library(iNEXT) # Calculation of richness estimators #
library(MuMIn) # Model selection
library(matrixStats) # Calculation of weighted median
library(RColorBrewer)
library(arm)
library(ade4)
library(semPlot)
  
setwd("D:/Other-project/N/New_1439/12.SEM")
df<-read.csv("all_sem.csv",header=T,row.names = 1)
# 读取您的数据
 # 标准化数据
env_20<-df[df$depth=="20",]
env_20[env_20 == "#N/A"] <- NA
env_20_clean <- na.omit(env_20)
env_20_clean$Multifunction<-as.numeric(env_20_clean$Multifunction)
 #data_scaled <- as.data.frame(scale(env_p4_20_clean))
 
 # 检查和清理数据
 # 这里您需要根据您的数据特性进行适当的数据清理
 
 # 模型定义
 #0-20cm
 model1 <- '
  Multifunction ~ relative.abundance4+relative.abundance2+pcoa1_2+NDVI+AN+MAT+clay 
  richness4 ~ NDVI+pH+AN+clay+MAT
  pcoa1_4 ~ pH+clay+MAT
  relative.abundance4 ~ pH+AN+clay+MAT
  richness2  ~ NDVI+pH+MAT
  pcoa1_2 ~ pH+AN+clay+MAT
  relative.abundance2 ~ NDVI+MAT
  NDVI ~ MAT+pH+AN
  clay ~ MAT
  pH ~ MAT
  AN ~ MAT
  richness4 ~~ pcoa1_4+relative.abundance4
  richness2 ~~ pcoa1_2+relative.abundance2
  relative.abundance4 ~~ relative.abundance2
   pcoa1_4 ~~             pcoa1_2
   richness4 ~~           richness2
   clay ~~                  pH
    pH ~~                  AN
    richness4 ~~             pcoa1_2
    pcoa1_4 ~~ relative.abundance2
    relative.abundance4 ~~             pcoa1_2
    richness4 ~~ relative.abundance2
    relative.abundance4 ~~           richness2
 '
 fit <- sem(model1, data = env_20_clean)

 ## 使用SEM函数拟合模型
 summary(fit)
  #寻找遗漏的链接
 mod_indices<-modindices(fit)
 mod_indices[mod_indices$mi > 3.841, ]
 fitMeasures(fit,c("chisq","df","pvalue","gfi","cfi","rmr","srmr","rmsea","aic","bic"))
 
 summary(fit)  #模型简化将P值（大于0.05）最大的路径删除
 summary(fit, fit.measures=TRUE)
  fitMeasures(fit,c("chisq","df","pvalue","gfi","cfi","rmr","srmr","rmsea","aic","bic"))
 #模型合适时获取标准参数
 summary(fit, standardized = TRUE,rsq = T)
 
df<-read.csv("all_sem.csv",header=T,row.names = 1)
# 读取您的数据
 # 标准化数据
env_50<-df[df$depth=="50",]
env_50[env_50 == "#N/A"] <- NA
env_50_clean <- na.omit(env_50)
env_50_clean$Multifunction<-as.numeric(env_50_clean$Multifunction)
  
  model2 <- '
   Multifunction ~ relative.abundance2+clay+AN+pH+NDVI+richness4+MAT  
  richness4 ~ NDVI+pH+AN+MAT
  pcoa1_4 ~ pH+AN+clay+MAT
  relative.abundance4 ~ pH+clay+MAT
  richness2  ~ NDVI+pH+clay+MAT
  pcoa1_2 ~ NDVI+pH+MAT
  relative.abundance2 ~ NDVI+pH+AN+clay+MAT
  NDVI ~ MAT+pH
  clay ~ MAT
  pH ~ MAT
  AN ~ MAT
  richness4 ~~ pcoa1_4+relative.abundance4
  pcoa1_4 ~~ relative.abundance4
  richness2 ~~ pcoa1_2+relative.abundance2
   pcoa1_2 ~~ relative.abundance2
  relative.abundance4 ~~ relative.abundance2
   pcoa1_4 ~~             pcoa1_2
   richness4 ~~           richness2
   richness4 ~~             pcoa1_2
   richness4 ~~ relative.abundance2 
   clay ~~     pH
   clay ~~    AN 
   pcoa1_4 ~~ relative.abundance2
   relative.abundance4 ~~           richness2+pcoa1_2 
'
 fit2 <- sem(model2, data = env_50_clean)
 summary(fit2)
 mod_indices2<-modindices(fit2)
 mod_indices2[mod_indices2$mi > 3.841, ]
 fitMeasures(fit2,c("chisq","df","pvalue","gfi","cfi","rmr","srmr","rmsea","aic","bic"))
 
 summary(fit2, standardized = TRUE,rsq = T)

 
  #50-100cm
 
 df<-read.csv("all_sem.csv",header=T,row.names = 1)
# 读取您的数据
 # 标准化数据
env_100<-df[df$depth=="100",]
env_100[env_100 == "#N/A"] <- NA
env_100_clean <- na.omit(env_100)
env_100_clean$Multifunction<-as.numeric(env_100_clean$Multifunction)
  model3 <- '
  Multifunction ~ relative.abundance4+relative.abundance2+NDVI+clay+richness4+MAT
  richness4 ~ NDVI+pH+clay+MAT
  pcoa1_4 ~ pH+MAT
  relative.abundance4 ~ pH+MAT
  richness2  ~ NDVI+pH+clay+MAT
  pcoa1_2 ~ pH+MAT
  relative.abundance2 ~ NDVI+MAT
  NDVI ~ MAT+pH
  clay ~ MAT
  pH ~ MAT
  richness4 ~~ pcoa1_4+relative.abundance4
  pcoa1_4 ~~ relative.abundance4
  richness2 ~~ pcoa1_2+relative.abundance2
   pcoa1_2 ~~ relative.abundance2
   relative.abundance4 ~~relative.abundance2+richness2+pcoa1_2
   richness4  ~~ relative.abundance2+richness2+pcoa1_2
   pcoa1_4 ~~ relative.abundance2+richness2+pcoa1_2
'
  fit3 <- sem(model3, data = env_100_clean)
 summary(fit3)
 mod_indices3<-modindices(fit3)
 mod_indices3[mod_indices3$mi > 3.841, ]
 fitMeasures(fit3,c("chisq","df","pvalue","gfi","cfi","rmr","srmr","rmsea","aic","bic"))
 summary(fit3, standardized = TRUE,rsq = T)

 
 
pdf("sem_plot.pdf", family = "sans")

# 使用 semPaths 绘制路径图
semPaths(
    fit2,
    what = "std",
    whatLabels = "std",
    residuals = FALSE,
    layout = manual_layout,  # 使用手动布局
    fade = FALSE,
    edge.color = "dodgerblue3",
    edge.label.cex = 0.8,    # 调整边的标签大小 (变小)
    label.cex = 1.5,         # 调整节点标签大小 (变小)
    label.prop = 0.8,
    edge.label.color = "black",
    nCharNodes = 9,          # 节点标签的字符限制
    shapeMan = "square",     # 节点形状
    sizeMan = 3,             # 节点大小 (变小)
    curve = 1,               # 路径弧度
    rotation = 2,            # 从上到下
    layoutSplit = FALSE      # 禁止自动布局拆分
)

# 关闭 PDF 设备以保存文件
dev.off()
```

```{r}
setwd("D:/Other-project/N/New_1439/1.1相对丰度")
df<-read.csv("abundance_scale.csv",header=T,row.names = 1)
result <- sub(".*[[:alpha:]]", "", row.names(df))
all_2=df[result=="2",]
cor_2<-cor(all_2)
all_5=df[result=="5",]
cor_5<-cor(all_5)
cor_5
all_10=df[result=="10",]
cor_10<-cor(all_10)
cor_10

env<-read.csv("env_china_update_1439.csv",header=T,row.names = 1)
df_env<-merge(df,env,by = "row.names")
mode_Denitrification <- lm (Denitrification ~ All,data=df)
res1<-data.frame(residuals(mode_Denitrification))

mode_Dissimilatory_nitrate_reduction <- lm (Dissimilatory.nitrate.reduction ~ All,data=df)
res2<-data.frame(residuals(mode_Dissimilatory_nitrate_reduction))

mode_Nitrification <- lm (Nitrification ~ All,data=df)
res3<-data.frame(residuals(mode_Nitrification))

mode_Assimilatory_nitrate_reduction <- lm (Assimilatory.nitrate.reduction ~ All,data=df)
res4<-data.frame(residuals(mode_Assimilatory_nitrate_reduction))

mode_Organic_degradation_and_synthesis <- lm (Organic.degradation.and.synthes ~ All,data=df)
res5<-data.frame(residuals(mode_Organic_degradation_and_synthesis))

mode_Nitrogen_fixation <- lm (Nitrogen.fixation ~ All,data=df)
res6<-data.frame(residuals(mode_Nitrogen_fixation))


res_all<-  cbind(res1, res2, res3,res4,res5,res6)
colnames(res_all) <- c("Denitrification","Dissimilatory_nitrate_reduction","Nitrification","Assimilatory_nitrate_reduction","Organic_degradation_and_synthesis","Nitrogen_fixation")
write.csv(res_all,"res_all.csv")
```

#5. correlation
```{r}
library(linkET)
library(ggtext)
library(dplyr)
library(cols4all)
library(reshape2)
library(ggplot2)

##基因间相关分析
setwd("D:/Other-project/N/New_1439/1.显著相关")
df<-read.csv("D:/Other-project/N/New_1439/1.显著相关/all_scale_pathway.csv",header = T,row.names=1)
evn <- df
cplot=function(evn,size=1){
  cor2 <- correlate(evn)
  corr2 <- cor2 %>% as_md_tbl()
  
  for (i in 1:ncol(evn)) {
    k=c((ncol(evn)*(i-1)+1):(ncol(evn)*(i-1)+i))
    corr2[k,4]=1
  }
  
  # 定义分类条件
  threshold1 <- 0.0001
  threshold2 <- 0.001
  threshold3 <- 0.01
  
  # 使用ifelse()函数对元素进行分类
  corr2$pa <- factor(ifelse(corr2$p < threshold1, "<0.0001",
                           ifelse(corr2$p < threshold2, "<0.001",
                                   ifelse(corr2$p < threshold3, "<0.01",">0.01"))), 
                     levels = c("<0.0001", "<0.001", "<0.01", ">0.01"))
  
  
  qcorrplot(cor2,
            grid_col = "white",
            grid_size = 0.2,
            type = "lower",
            diag = FALSE,
            drop=T,
            size=2,
            facets_order =colnames(evn))+
    ggtitle("Residual")+
    geom_tile(colour = "white",linewidth=1.0) +
    #geom_point(data=corr2,
         #aes(shape=factor(pa,levels=c("<0.0001","<0.001","<0.01",">0.01"))),
         #size=size)+
    geom_mark(sep = '\n',size = 3.5, sig_level = c(0.01, 0.001, 0.0001),
                   sig_thres = 0.05, color = 'grey0') +
         
         scale_fill_gradient2(low="#4DBBD5CC", high = "#E64B35CC",
                              limits = c(-1, 1))+
    scale_shape_manual(values = c("<0.0001" = 19, "<0.001" =20 , "<0.01" = 0, ">0.01" = NA))+
    theme(legend.position = "right")+
    labs(shape="p")
}

cor2
```

```{r}
p <- ggplot(df_10, aes(richness, Multifunction)) +
  geom_point(color = "lightblue4", size = 2, alpha = 0.65) +
  stat_smooth(color = "black", formula = y ~ x, fill = "lightblue3", method = "lm") +
  stat_poly_eq(
    aes(label = paste(..eq.label.., ..rr.label.., ..p.value.label.., sep = '~~~~')),
    formula = y ~ x, parse = TRUE,
    size = 5, label.x = 0.1, label.y = 1,
    rr.digits = 3  # R² 保留三位小数
  ) +
  theme_bw() +
  theme(
    axis.text = element_text(colour = 'black', size = 9),
    panel.grid.major = element_blank(),  # 移除主网格线
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank()   # 移除次网格线
  ) +
  scale_fill_brewer(palette = "Set2") +
  labs(y = "Multi-functionality at 50-100cm")  # 更改 y 轴标签

print(p)
```

```{r}
library(ggplot2)
library(dplyr)

library(ggpubr)

setwd("D:/Other-project/N/New_1439/增温/last/abundance")

           "Assimilatory.nitrate.reduction", "Organic.degradation","Organic.synthesis", 
           "Nitrogen.fixation")
# df_0<-df[df$map=="0",]
# df_1<-df[df$map=="1",]
data<-df

  t_test(Organic.synthesis ~ mat, paired = FALSE) %>%
  add_significance()
t_test_results
library(doBy)


# --------------------------
# 步骤2: 绘制小提琴图 + 配对线
# --------------------------
ggplot(a, aes(x = factor(mat), y = Nitrogen.fixation)) +  # 确保x转换为factor
  # 小提琴图层（显示数据分布）
  geom_violin(
    aes(fill = factor(mat)),  # 填充颜色基于mat
    width = 0.7, 
    alpha = 0.5,
    trim = FALSE
  ) +
  # 箱型图层（显示中位数、四分位数）
  geom_boxplot(
    width = 0.15,
    outlier.shape = NA
  ) +
  # 添加配对连线（假设数据是成对样本）
  geom_line(
    aes(group = mat),  # 需替换为实际的配对样本ID列名
    color = "gray40",
    alpha = 0.6,
    linetype = "dashed"
  ) +
  # 添加数据点
  geom_jitter(
    aes(color = factor(mat)),  # 颜色与填充一致
    width = 0.1,
    size = 2,
    alpha = 0.8
  ) +  
  # 自定义颜色（匹配0/1编码）
  scale_fill_manual(
    values = c("0" = "goldenrod", "1" = "darkorange"),
    labels = c("0" = "未处理", "1" = "处理")  # 可选：设置图例标签
  ) +
  scale_color_manual(
    values = c("0" = "goldenrod", "1" = "darkorange"),
    guide = "none"  # 隐藏颜色图例（与填充图例合并）
  ) +
  theme_bw() +
  # 可选：优化图例位置和样式
  theme(
    legend.position = "right",
    legend.title = element_text(face = "bold", size = 9),
    legend.text = element_text(size = 8)
  )
```
